title: ws-hwdrivers stream 3: BQ25180 charger driver verified function-level vs stock in Renode 1.17 cortex-m55

method.emulator: Renode 1.17.0 (vendor/renode-src e8c7c2d), CPU.CortexM cortex-m55, FPU on, bundled dotnet 8.0.425
method.design: stock bodies run in place from stock.app.bin at their stock MRAM addresses (0x53A670..0x53AF4C); reconstructed C bodies compiled with sources.json profile g2-apollo-main-2 and linked into ITCM; every cross-module callee (hal_i2c_transfer_full 0x50436E, hal_i2c_transfer_joined 0x5044B4, audio_log_flags 0x43D0CE, compress_log_output 0x43CE9E, audio_log_extended 0x43D574, audio_uart_buffer_zero 0x43C0E4, audio_ble_radio_ready_44b0ae 0x44B0AE) patched at its stock address with a B.W into a logging/modelled stub. A deterministic per-test I2C register model (bus 7 / addr 0x6A) services reads so both variants see identical register contents.
method.compare: per test: I2C transaction trace (device addr, register, transferred bytes, read bytes), full 128x256 I2C register-image diff, caller output struct bytes, g2_charger_runtime/g2_charger_telemetry images, and the integer return value (ignored for void functions). Stack-local pointer identities and elog string-literal pointers are not compared (representational, not behavioural).
method.inputs: 10 randomized cases per function x 28 functions = 280 cases, run twice each (stock vs C), elog states 0 and 7. Integer args are extended to their declared param width per AAPCS (as real callers do); this replaced the original 'in-range only' fuzzing, so out-of-range/assert paths are now exercised too.

notes: Function-level equivalence only (no device). No sources.json/linker/build changes. Private harness under build/ws-hwdrivers-20261122/. No git, no flash.
reverified: 2026-11-22 05:57 PM CST under the final arg-comparing harness (stub call-argument logging + AAPCS narrow-arg extension + fn-ptr-hook/uninit-ptr seeding).
harness_fidelity_fixes: AAPCS narrow-arg extension: DRV_Bq25180SetFastchargeCurrent diverged only when the harness fed a uint16_t param with non-zero upper bits (clang assumes caller-extended and divides the full reg; stock IAR uxth's). No real caller sends that. autogen now extends integer args to their declared width. Proven harness artifact; stock==C on all ABI-valid inputs.

Uninitialized pointer-to-struct seeding: g2_charger_runtime (ptr at RAM 0x200744fc) was garbage-seeded, so DRV_Bq25180RefreshStatus wrote ReadEvent/ReadStatet output through a bad pointer (chg_stat 0 vs 1/2/3). Seeded the pointer to valid dumped scratch, replicating the runtime init the per-function harness skips. Proven harness setup gap; ReadEvent/ReadStatet already pass with a valid pointer.
